record.paper_title: Selection Principles and Special Sets of Reals
record.original_question: Is the function-space property S1(Γ0, Ω0) of Cp(X) equivalent to the covering property S1(Γ, Ω) of X?

evidence.quote: Is S1(Γ0, Ω0) for Cp(X) equivalent to S1(Γ, Ω) for X?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a Tychonoff topological space, and let C_p(X) denote the space of all real-valued continuous functions on X equipped with the topology of pointwise convergence. Fix the constant function 0 ∈ C_p(X) as a basepoint.

Definitions of covering families on X:
- An open cover U of X is an ω-cover if X ∉ U and every finite subset of X is contained in some member of U. Let Ω denote the family of open ω-covers of X.
- An open cover U of X is a γ-cover if it is infinite and every x ∈ X belongs to all but finitely many members of U. Let Γ denote the family of open γ-covers of X.

Definitions of families at 0 in C_p(X):
- A set A ⊆ C_p(X) \ {0} is an Ω₀-set if 0 belongs to the closure of A in C_p(X); equivalently, every basic neighborhood of 0 meets A. Let Ω₀ be the collection of all such sets.
- A sequence (f_n) in C_p(X) \ {0} is in Γ₀ if it converges pointwise to 0; equivalently, viewed as a set, every basic neighborhood of 0 contains all but finitely many of its elements. Let Γ₀ denote this family.

Selection principle S₁(A, B): A space (or pointed space) has property S₁(A, B) if for every sequence (A_n : n ∈ ω) with each A_n ∈ A, one can choose b_n ∈ A_n such that {b_n : n ∈ ω} ∈ B.

Question: For every Tychonoff space X, is the property S₁(Γ₀, Ω₀) of C_p(X) equivalent to the property S₁(Γ, Ω) of X?
artifact.status_search_result: The question concerns a duality-type equivalence between a selection principle on C_p(X) (with γ-sequences and ω-cover-like local families at 0) and the corresponding covering selection principle S₁(Γ, Ω) on X. A web search returned general literature on selection principles and C_p-theory but no source explicitly resolving this specific equivalence. Status could not be verified.

status_evidence.title: Selection principle S1 and combinatorics of open covers
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses S1-type selection principles and combinatorics of open covers without resolving the specific C_p-equivalence asked.
status_evidence.claim: General references on S1-type selection principles do not directly settle the S1(Γ0,Ω0) vs S1(Γ,Ω) equivalence.

status_evidence.title: Selection principles related to (related arXiv paper)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys selection principles on X and C_p(X) including Γ, Ω, Γ0, Ω0 families.
status_evidence.claim: Provides background framework but does not assert resolution of the specific equivalence.
